payload.title: Analytical candidate construction
payload.construction: Choose the eight deterministic strategies with exactly one mismatch relative to PR target signs; each strategy has a global-output-flip partner. Let J denote the unique mismatch setting pair. P(J=j|X=x)=r if j=x and (1-r)/3 otherwise. The flip partner is equiprobable.
payload.derivation: Each correlator is c_x(1-2r), giving S=4(1-2r). J is uniform marginally, H(J)=2, and H(J|X)=h2(r)+(1-r)log2(3). Thus I(Lambda;X)=I(J;X) for this construction.
payload.caveat: Initially this was an attaining candidate family, not yet a global optimality proof. Candidate has zero probabilities for eight strategies; it is nonnegative, not strictly positive.
